tiktok.author: clairelikesgraphicdesign
tiktok.body:
I love you guys forever @NOVA: The Creative Network !! 🫶 #freelancer #graphicdesigntips #careeradvice #careertok #jobsearch
In less than six months, I went from college graduate to full time freelance graphic designer working with clients like Chili's, your Beromade, Pop's, Blue Ribbon, Lego, and so many more. And I literally owe my entire career to a single app that I have been gatekeeping up until this point. But I feel like I owe it to you guys and to the creative community to share this little best kept secret. This is literally not an ad. I'm just obsessed with them. The app I'm talking about is called Nova, and it is essentially Instagram meets LinkedIn for creatives, whether it's graphic design, editing, directing, hair and makeup, even crew roles in film like grips, first AC, stuff like that. They have positions for everybody on there. You have a little profile, a little portfolio. You upload work just like you would post an Instagram post. You do a little carousel. You can tag other creatives if they collaborated with you on the project. If you're creative looking at jobs, there is a $13 a month fee, and you essentially just get access to all of these privately listed jobs that aren't listed anywhere else. And then when you're applying to jobs, you just attach relevant projects that kind of fit the job description that someone's looking for. And you attach a little blurb. You can link your portfolio, anything you want that you think will help get you the position. Anyone who's posting a job, the positions Are all completely vetted by the Nova team, so you know when you're applying to a stuff that you're not applying to some random scam position like a lot of the ones on LinkedIn are. Nova genuinely changed my life. Like, I'm not being dramatic. I work full time 9 to 5 everyday. I'm my own boss now because of this app. So if you're a creative and you're not on Nova yet, literally get over there right now.
